subject: hurricane_pike
description_en: Active: Hurricane Thrust  Pushes you and target enemy %enemy_length% units away from each other, and for %range_duration% seconds, allows you to make %max_attacks% attacks against the target without range restrictions and with +%bonus_attack_speed% attack speed.  Can be cast on self or allies to push the target %push_length% units in the direction it is facing. Enemy Range: %cast_range_enemy%
notes_en: Self-cast will use Hurricane Pike on yourself.
Hurricane Pike doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Attack Range bonuses from Monkey King Bar and Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.

subject: hydras_breath
description_en: Passive: Miasma Attacks poison enemies, dealing %poison_damage_per_second%%% of the target's Max HP as Magical Damage per second for %poison_duration% seconds.   Passive: Polycephaly Ranged attacks have a %proc_chance%%% chance to fire additional projectiles at up to %count% nearby enemies with %secondary_target_range_bonus% extra range and within a %secondary_target_angle% degree angle in front of the attacker. The additional projectiles deal %base_proc_dmg% + %proc_dmg_pct%%% damage of a normal attack and do not trigger on hit effects except for Miasma. The primary attack deals %base_proc_dmg% + %proc_dmg_pct_primary_tooltip%%% damage of a normal attack.
notes_en: Attack Range bonuses from Monkey King Bar and Dragon Lance and its upgrades do not stack.

subject: infused_raindrop
description_en: Passive: Magical Damage Block  Consumes a charge to block %magic_damage_block% magic damage from damage instances over %min_damage% damage.   Comes with %initial_charges% charges. When the charges are gone, the item disappears.
notes_en: Uses at most one charge per damage instance.

subject: invis_sword
description_en: Active: Shadow Walk Makes you invisible for %windwalk_duration% seconds, or until you attack or cast a spell.  While Shadow Walk is active, you move %windwalk_movement_speed%%% faster and can move through units.    If attacking to end the invisibility, you gain %windwalk_bonus_damage% bonus physical damage on that attack.
notes_en: Has a %windwalk_fade_time% second fade time.
If the invisibility ends without attacking, the bonus damage is lost.

subject: javelin
description_en: Passive: Pierce Grants each attack a %bonus_chance%%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus magical damage.

subject: lesser_crit
description_en: Passive: Critical Strike Grants each attack a %crit_chance%%% chance to deal %crit_multiplier%%% damage.
notes_en: Critical Strike does not work against buildings.

subject: lifesteal
description_en: Passive: Lifesteal Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

subject: lotus_orb
description_en: Active: Echo Shell Applies a shield to the target unit for %active_duration% seconds which re-casts most targeted spells back to their caster.  The shielded unit will still take damage from the spell. Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel
notes_en: Targeted abilities from neutral items do not trigger Echo Shell.

subject: maelstrom
description_en: Passive: Chain Lightning Grants a %chain_chance%%% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between %chain_strikes% targets within a %chain_radius% radius, dealing %chain_damage% magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.

subject: mage_slayer
description_en: Passive: Mage Slayer Places a debuff when you attack enemies, dealing %dps% physical damage per second and causing them to do %spell_amp_debuff%%% less spell damage for %duration% seconds.

subject: magic_stick
description_en: Active: Energy Charge  Instantly restores %restore_per_charge% health and mana per charge stored.   Max %max_charges% charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within %charge_radius% range uses an ability.
notes_en: Gains charges for spells cast by visible enemies in 1200 range.
Certain abilities and item abilities will not add charges.

subject: magic_wand
description_en: Active: Energy Charge Instantly restores %restore_per_charge% health and mana per charge stored.   Max %max_charges% charges. Gains a charge whenever a visible enemy within %charge_radius% range uses an ability.
notes_en: Gains charges for spells cast by visible enemies in 1200 range.
Certain abilities and item abilities will not add charges.

subject: manta
description_en: Active: Mirror Image Creates %images_count% images of your hero that last %illusion_duration% seconds.   Melee images deal %tooltip_damage_outgoing_melee%%% damage, while Ranged images deal %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%%. Illusions take %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.   Dispel Type:  Basic Dispel
notes_en: Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.
Many effects are removed upon using Manta.
Yasha based movement speed bonuses from multiple items do not stack.

subject: mask_of_madness
description_en: Active: Berserk Gives %berserk_bonus_attack_speed% attack speed, %berserk_bonus_movement_speed%%% / %berserk_bonus_movement_speed_melee%%% movement speed (ranged/melee), and %berserk_slow_resist%%%/%berserk_slow_resist_melee%%% slow resistance (ranged/melee), but reduces your armor by %berserk_armor_reduction% and silences you.  Lasts %berserk_duration% seconds.   Passive: Lifesteal Heals the attacker for a percentage of physical damage dealt.

subject: mekansm
description_en: Active: Restore Restores %heal_amount% health to allied units in a %heal_radius% radius.   Passive: Mekansm Aura Grants %aura_health_regen% health regeneration to allied units in a %aura_radius% radius.
notes_en: Restore does not affect units that have been affected by Restore or Guardian Greaves Mend within Mekansm's cooldown.
Multiple instances of Mekansm Aura do not stack.

subject: meteor_hammer
description_en: Active: Meteor Hammer  CHANNELED - After a successful channel, summons a meteor that strikes a %impact_radius% AoE, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds and dealing impact damage. Continues to deal damage over time to enemies units and buildings for %burn_duration% seconds. Non-building units are also slowed for %burn_slow%%% for the duration of the burn.   Building Impact Damage: %impact_damage_buildings%  Building Over Time Damage: %burn_dps_buildings%   Non-Building Impact Damage: %impact_damage_units%  Non-Building Over Time Damage: %burn_dps_units%   Channel Duration: %max_duration% seconds. Landing Time: %land_time% seconds.

subject: mjollnir
description_en: Active: Static Charge Places a charged shield on a target unit for %static_duration% seconds which has a %static_chance%%% chance to release a %static_damage% magical damage shocking bolt at a nearby attacker and %static_strikes% additional enemies.   Passive: Chain Lightning Grants a %chain_chance%%% chance on attack to release a bolt of electricity that leaps between %chain_strikes% targets within a %chain_radius% radius, dealing %chain_damage% magical damage to each. Lightning proc pierces evasion.
notes_en: Static Charge cannot trigger more than once per second.
Static Charge's shock deals magical damage centered on hero with the Static Charge. Static Charge's targets cannot be more than %static_seconary_radius% range away.
Static Charge procs will not bounce to heroes that are invisible or hidden by Fog of War.

subject: monkey_king_bar
description_en: Passive: Pierce Grants each attack a %bonus_chance%%% chance to pierce through evasion and deal %bonus_chance_damage% bonus magical damage.

subject: moon_shard
description_en: Use: Consume  Consume the Moon Shard to permanently gain %consumed_bonus% attack speed and %consumed_bonus_night_vision% bonus night vision. Max 1 use.   Passive: Shade Sight Grants bonus night vision.
